edges.reason: block.timestamp is truncated to uint32 to produce the current block timestamp, creating a timestamp dependency.
currentCumulativePrices invokes currentBlockTimestamp to obtain the current time.
UniOracle.update calls the oracle library helper to fetch cumulative prices and the timestamp.
currentCumulativePrices performs the unchecked uint32 subtraction blockTimestamp - blockTimestampLast.
block.timestamp determines the elapsed time used in the counterfactual price accumulation.
update computes timeElapsed = blockTimestamp - blockTimestampLast with wrapping arithmetic.
block-derived timestamp flows into timeElapsed, making the update gate dependent on block.timestamp.
stored blockTimestampLast is subtracted from the newly observed timestamp.
timeElapsed is compared against PERIOD to decide whether the update may proceed.
timeElapsed is used as the divisor when averaging the cumulative price delta.
update performs unchecked subtraction of cumulative prices and division by timeElapsed.
price0CumulativeLast state variable is read in the subtraction.
price1CumulativeLast state variable is read in the subtraction.
the averaged cumulative delta is written into price0Average.
the averaged cumulative delta is written into price1Average.
update stores the freshly observed cumulative price in price0CumulativeLast.
update stores the freshly observed cumulative price in price1CumulativeLast.
update stores the new observation timestamp in blockTimestampLast.
update reads the pair state variable to query reserves and cumulative prices.
caller-supplied token address selects which stored average price is used in consult.
caller-supplied amountIn is the input of the consult price conversion.
consult multiplies the stored fixed-point average by amountIn.
price0Average is read for the fixed point multiplication.
price1Average is read for the fixed point multiplication.
amountIn feeds the FixedPoint.mul overflow-checked multiplication.
the decoded multiplication result is assigned to the returned local amountOut.
the constructor derives the pair address via UniswapV2Library.pairFor.
factory address parameter is used to derive the pair contract.
tokenA parameter is used to derive the pair and seed oracle state.
tokenB parameter is used to derive the pair and seed oracle state.
the locally derived pair contract is stored in the pair state variable.
the constructor caches token0 read from the pair.
the constructor caches token1 read from the pair.
the constructor initialises price0CumulativeLast from the pair.
the constructor initialises price1CumulativeLast from the pair.
the constructor initialises blockTimestampLast from the pair reserves.
getPair computes the deterministic pair address through the library.
the hardcoded FACTORY address is used as the CREATE2 deployer in pair derivation.
deploy computes the pair address before instantiating the oracle.
tokenA parameter is used for pair lookup and oracle creation.
tokenB parameter is used for pair lookup and oracle creation.
deploy writes the newly created oracle address into the lookups mapping.
deploy reads lookups to enforce that no oracle exists for the pair yet.
deploy appends the new oracle address to the _oracles array.
deploy appends the pair address to the _pairs array.
deploy instantiates a new UniOracle contract, invoking its constructor.
factory update resolves the pair address through getPair.
factory update performs an external call into the oracle contract, which may re-enter the factory before state is settled.
lookups mapping is read to obtain the oracle address for the pair.
tokenA parameter is used to resolve the pair for the update call.
tokenB parameter is used to resolve the pair for the update call.
quote resolves the pair address through getPair.
quote performs an external static call into UniOracle.consult.
lookups mapping is read to obtain the oracle address for the pair.
tokenIn parameter is used to resolve the pair and query price.
tokenOut parameter is used to resolve the pair address.
amountIn parameter is forwarded to the oracle consult call.
the consult result is returned as the local amountOut.
oracles view returns the _oracles array contents.
pairs view returns the _pairs array contents.
pair address parameter is used to query reserves and cumulative price getters.

normalization_plan.reason: The token parameter only exists inside consult and is fully captured by that core function node.
amountIn is consumed directly by the FixedPoint.mul unsafe operation inside consult.
The amountOut return variable is a purely local artefact of consult.
tokenA is only meaningful within deploy for pair derivation.
tokenB is only meaningful within deploy for pair derivation.
tokenA is only used by the factory update forwarder.
tokenB is only used by the factory update forwarder.
tokenIn is only meaningful inside the quote view function.
tokenOut is only meaningful inside the quote view function.
amountIn is a transient argument of the quote forwarder.
The amountOut return variable is a purely local artefact of quote.
The factory argument is only consumed during oracle construction.
The tokenA argument is only consumed during oracle construction.
The tokenB argument is only consumed during oracle construction.
The _pair local is created and stored within the constructor.
The pair address parameter is only used inside the cumulative price helper.
timeElapsed is produced and immediately consumed by the wrapping timestamp subtraction and period gate.
